Job Overview
 We are looking for a highly creative and detail-oriented Multimedia Video & Graphic Designer to join our team. This role will be responsible for producing engaging, high-quality video and graphic content across digital platforms.
 The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with Adobe Premiere Pro and Canva , a sharp eye for visual storytelling, and a passion for experimenting with new creative techniques and AI-powered tools. You should be comfortable taking a concept from idea to finished asset while balancing creativity, brand consistency, deadlines, and performance goals.
 Key Responsibilities

• Create, edit, and produce high-quality video content for social media, marketing campaigns, advertisements, presentations, and other digital channels.

• Edit and enhance video footage using Adobe Premiere Pro .

• Create graphics, social media assets, thumbnails, presentations, and other visual materials using Canva .

• Transform raw footage, concepts, scripts, and creative briefs into polished and engaging content.

• Apply strong visual storytelling, pacing, transitions, typography, composition, and sound design principles.

• Repurpose existing content into multiple formats and platform-specific assets.

• Collaborate with marketing, creative, and other internal teams to develop content aligned with brand guidelines and campaign objectives.

• Review creative performance and feedback, then make revisions and improvements when needed.

• Stay current with emerging design, video editing, social media, and visual content trends.

• Explore and implement AI-powered tools that can improve the speed, quality, and efficiency of the creative workflow.

• Maintain organized project files, source assets, templates, and final deliverables.

 Required QualificationsVideo Editing

• 3+ years of professional experience in video editing, multimedia design, graphic design, or a related creative role. 

• Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro — MUST HAVE .

• Experience editing short-form and long-form video content.

• Strong understanding of video pacing, transitions, audio, color correction, typography, and visual storytelling.

• Ability to take raw footage and turn it into compelling, polished content.

 Graphic & Photo Editing

• Strong proficiency in Canva — MUST HAVE .

• Experience creating social media graphics, thumbnails, marketing materials, presentations, and other digital assets.

• Strong understanding of layout, typography, color, composition, branding, and visual hierarchy.

• Ability to maintain visual consistency across multiple content formats.

 AI & Creative Technology

• Hands-on experience incorporating AI tools into creative workflows .

• Familiarity with AI applications for tasks such as:

• AI voice enhancement and cleanup

• Auto-captioning and transcription

• Auto-framing and smart editing

• Generative fill and image manipulation

• AI-assisted script and copy generation

• AI image/video generation

• Asset creation and creative ideation

• Workflow automation

• Demonstrated ability to use AI to improve efficiency without compromising creative quality.

 Nice-to-Have Skills

• Experience with Adobe After Effects .

• Experience with Adobe Photoshop .

• Familiarity with other Adobe Creative Suite applications.

• Experience with motion graphics and animation.

• Experience creating content for social media platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and LinkedIn.

• Understanding of different video formats, aspect ratios, resolutions, and platform specifications.

• Experience working with remote teams and managing multiple creative projects simultaneously.

 What We're Looking For
 We're looking for someone who is:

• Creative: You naturally think visually and enjoy finding fresh ways to communicate ideas.

• Detail-oriented: You notice the small things that make content feel polished and professional.

• Curious: You're constantly exploring new tools, techniques, trends, and creative approaches.

• AI-forward: You actively look for ways to use AI to enhance—not replace—your creative process.

• Adaptable: You can take feedback, experiment with different creative directions, and pivot when something isn't working.

• Efficient: You know how to balance creativity with deadlines and production requirements.

• Collaborative: You can communicate creative ideas clearly and work effectively with other team members.

• Self-directed: You can manage projects independently and take ownership of your deliverables.
